issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification DSTU1 Patient Care issue asking to add ReferralRequest.date with the definition "date of creation for draft requests and date of activation for active requests" so wait time could be tracked.
initial_application: Historical commit a7344a39aa35eeb8f52cb6d13a8e63eabd6105b2 added ReferralRequest.date and a date search parameter. Later workflow-alignment history moved the concept to ReferralRequest.authoredOn before ReferralRequest was merged into the current ServiceRequest resource.
additional_context: ReferralRequest is no longer an active current-build resource. source/fhir.ini marks ServiceRequest as active, notes that ReferralRequest became ServiceRequest, and keeps a migration map from ReferralRequest.date to ReferralRequest.authoredOn. Later Published request-resource decisions, including FHIR-10293, FHIR-10296, FHIR-11119, FHIR-13196, and FHIR-13867, aligned request resources, merged the relevant request concepts, and renamed the survivor to ServiceRequest.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was made because the active source already contains ServiceRequest.authoredOn and its date search parameter, and restoring the original DSTU1 ReferralRequest.date wording would disregard later applied request-pattern and merge decisions.
